en.heading: A WORLD OF TASTE & IMAGINATION
en.text: At Alice, every visit is an experience. From specialty coffee and handcrafted desserts to brunch at the Alice Eatery, custom cakes and curated corporate boxes — every detail is designed to delight.

en.heading: CORPORATE GIFTS
en.text: Elegant dessert boxes and curated packages for offices, events and special moments.

en.heading: The Story of Alice
en.text: Alice was born from a journey through London, Paris, and Rome — cities where café culture, elegance, and unforgettable flavours come together to create moments that stay with you forever.

en.heading: ALICE
en.text: Alice is more than a café. It is a space where coffee, desserts, brunch, and atmosphere come together to create a dreamlike experience. From the aroma of freshly brewed coffee to the beauty of handcrafted desserts, every detail is designed to awaken the senses.
